name: HEATERS
text:
Heaters are an integral part of an infrared sauna. If you’re looking to upgrade your heaters or to find a replacement for a part, you’ve come to the right place.

If a heater is not working correctly, or not exactly as it should, perhaps you need to get a new one. There is plenty of choice. You could find full spectrum and carbon sauna heaters. There are different types to choose from based on the look, feel, energy consumption, speed of heating.

If you are sure that the heater is broken, or it has stopped working for some reason. You can assess it with us using the troubleshooting form.

We’re looking forward to helping you find a replacement heater.
text_short:
Heater is one of the most important parts of any sauna equipment. It is the heart and soul of infrared sauna. Our company offers full-spectrum and carbon sauna heaters. We choose that particular kinds of heating units due to several reasons

Carbon and ceramic heaters combine effective and quick heating with efficient energy use.
